row:
The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center is one of the nation's leading academic medical centers. It is affiliated with The Ohio State University, the third-largest university in the U.S. and one of just two American universities with seven health science colleges on one campus. 

Our mission as one of America's top-ranked centers of academic health is to improve lives everywhere through innovation in research, education and patient care.
